guild.registered: I passed Rhea's trial. The Guild knows me as an adventurer now.
prologue.bar_seen: One bar of the cage was cracked near the floor.
prologue.cage_broken: The goblins that broke the cage carried new iron, not the rust goblins carry.
pip.told_barn: Pip hates the Lightborn: one of them burned his barn, and his dog, for a quest.
prologue.bram: Old Bram knew what I was before I said a word. He told me to hide Nell from anyone the Company knows.
anchor.bound: The Anchor Stone in the Guild knows me. If I fall, I wake there.
